data.summary: 实现并验证固定版本 Go App Server runtime；1.3、1.4、1.5、1.7 完成，1.6 因禁存及 restart/rollback 准入证据不足而 Gate，未发 implementation-ready。
commands: GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go build -o NUL .
AIW_RUN_CODEX_APP_SERVER_REAL_TURN=1 AIW_CODEX_JS_PATH=<installed Codex CLI entrypoint> go test -run '^TestCodexAppServerRealTurn$' -count=1 -v
results: Compile-only build passed with output directed to NUL.
Focused local fake App Server and Worker lifecycle tests passed after fixing process creation, cancellation terminal handling, and runtime evidence field admission.
One real Codex CLI 0.162.1 App Server turn passed in a temporary read-only workspace and graceful EOF shutdown completed.
No-store persistence behavior and full Worker restart/Exec rollback remain unverified; production-candidate admission is blocked.
data.residual_risk: Ephemeral thread mode and one real turn do not establish all CLI, host, or service-side persistence channels. Full Worker restart and Exec rollback runtime checks are not covered. FD remains In Progress and no Reviewer handoff was emitted.
